Module org.microbean.bean
Package org.microbean.bean

Record Class BeanSelectionCriteria

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.microbean.bean.BeanSelectionCriteria
Record Components:
typeMatcher - a non-null TypeMatcher used to determine whether two types match
type - a non-null TypeMirror representing the kind of Bean that should be selected
attributes - a (possibly null) List of NamedAttributeMap instances representing qualifiers, interceptor bindings, or both
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constable
public record BeanSelectionCriteria(TypeMatcher typeMatcher, TypeMirror type, List<NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes) extends Record implements Constable
An object that represents criteria used to select Beans according to rules used to match types and qualifiers.
Author:
Laird Nelson

      public final boolean selects(Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types, Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes)
      Returns true if an invocation of selectsQualifiers(Collection) supplied with the supplied attributes returns true, and if an invocation of selectsInterceptorBindings(Collection) supplied with the supplied attributes also returns true, and if an invocation of selectsTypeFrom(Collection) supplied with the supplied types returns true.
      Parameters:
      types - a Collection of TypeMirror instances; must not be null
      attributes - a Collection of NamedAttributeMap instances representing qualifiers, interceptor bindings or both
      Returns:
      true if an invocation of selectsQualifiers(Collection) supplied with the supplied attributes returns true, and if an invocation of selectsInterceptorBindings(Collection) supplied with the supplied attributes also returns true, and if an invocation of selectsTypeFrom(Collection) supplied with the supplied types returns true; false in all other cases
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either types or attributes is null
      See Also:
      • selectsInterceptorBindings(Collection)
      • selectsQualifiers(Collection)
      • selectsTypeFrom(Collection)

    • selectsQualifiers

      public final boolean selectsQualifiers(Collection<? extends NamedAttributeMap<?>> attributes)
      Returns true if and only if this BeanSelectionCriteria's qualifiers are contained by the qualifiers present in the supplied Collection of attributes.

      If the return value of an invocation of the qualifiers() method is empty, then this method behaves as if the return value of an invocation of Qualifiers.defaultQualifiers() were returned instead.

      If the supplied attributes has no qualifiers, then the return value of Qualifiers.anyAndDefaultQualifiers() will be used instead.

      Parameters:
      attributes - a Collection of NamedAttributeMap instances representing attributes; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if and only if this BeanSelectionCriteria's qualifiers are contained by the qualifiers present in the supplied Collection of attributes; false in all other cases
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if attributes is null
